thread:
noah: Quick sketch: central issues with quota double-credit. Proposal: short-lived "vouchers" from central ledger to regions; proxies admit optimistically against vouchers and reconcile. want quick sanity check.

anya: high level - what's a voucher?

noah: voucher is small credit bundle with ttl (10-30s) and region binding. proxies request allocate, consume locally. on reconcile we subtract usage.

leo: why vouchers vs frequent sync?

noah: vouchers bound the reconciliation surface and give audit trail. lower delta cardinality.

anya: abuse risk: cross-region double spend?

noah: mitigations: region binding, anti-dup headers, dedupe on reconcile, and coordinated-strict mode when heuristics detect cross-region reuse.

leo: sketch of API and rollout?

noah: POST /ledger/v1/vouchers/allocate -> {voucher_id, units, ttl}. rollout: emit-only -> shadow -> canary (internal) -> opt-in beta -> ramp. SLOs: false-fallback <0.3%, reconcile_gap99<5%.

dev-ops-bot: Runbook created: "edge-voucher-emergency-disable". steps: 1) set admin mode off, 2) run manual reconcile, 3) notify #incidents, 4) rollback.

anya: metrics we need before enabling: voucher_alloc_rate, voucher_overdraft_count, local_admit_vs_voucher, client_hot_markers, fallback_count, reconcile_latency.

noah: perf: +1 reconciler + voucher service; estimate 2 small pods per region. will include in RFC.

leo: keep admission policy small and auditable.

noah: will draft RFC with API contract, reconcile cadence (5-10s), micro-vouchers per client, abuse heuristics. posting next week. ping me for reviews.
